bible_verses.telugu: అల్ఫాయు ఓమెగయు నేనే5. వర్తమాన భూత భవిష్యత్కాలములలో ఉండువాడను నేనే అని సర్వాధి కారియు దేవుడునగు ప్రభువు సెలవిచ్చుచున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా మందిరమునకు వెళ్లుదమని జనులు నాతో అనినప్పుడు నేను సంతోషించితిని.
bible_verses.english: I rejoiced with those who said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord."

bible_verses.telugu: అప్పుడు అకస్మాత్తుగా మహా భూకంపము కలిగెను, చెరసాల పునాదులు అదరెను, వెంటనే తలుపులన్నియు తెరచుకొనెను, అందరి బంధకములు ఊడెను.
bible_verses.english: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, You are the Eternal One who holds ultimate victory over my life. Thank You for opening the doors that kept me captive and giving me a reason to rejoice today. Fill my heart with the boundless joy of Your presence whenever I worship You. I choose to lift my voice with gladness and celebrate all that You are. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, You are the Eternal One who holds ultimate victory over my life. Thank You for opening the doors that kept me captive and giving me a reason to rejoice today. devotional.reflection_english: From age to age, our God remains faithful, powerful, and victorious over every battle we face. He is the God who breaks impossible chains and leads us into His marvelous light. When we gather in His presence, we do not just remember what He did in the past; we celebrate His living power right now. Let your heart be filled with holy joy today, and let your voice give Him the uninhibited praise He so deeply deserves.
